scenarios.title: A｜要求解释
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经掌握了比较明确的信息，确认对象和另一个人发生了超越关系边界的行为。

turns.prompt: 关于「发现对象出轨」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I know you’ve been seeing someone else. I need you to explain what’s going on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you’ve been seeing someone else. I need you to explain what’s going on.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I found out about you and Taylor. I want to hear the truth from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I found out about you and Taylor. I want to hear the truth from you.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I know something happened between you two. How long has this been going on?

feedback.naturalExpression: I know something happened between you two. How long has this been going on?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: I’m giving you a chance to tell me exactly what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m giving you a chance to tell me exactly what happened.
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

choices.text: I know you cheated me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know you’ve been seeing someone else. I need you to explain what’s going on.
feedback.explanation: 伴侣出轨用“cheat on someone”；“cheat someone”通常指欺骗或诈骗对方。

turns.text: It’s not what you think. It only happened once.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方把事情经过说清楚，会怎么说？

choices.text: Then tell me what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then tell me what happened.
feedback.explanation: 直接请对方说明经过；在已经表明疑虑后，这样能把话题引向事实。

choices.text: What do you mean, “only once”?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you mean, “only once”?
feedback.explanation: 直接指出没理解的词或说法，让对方解释该部分，而不必重讲全部内容。

choices.text: When did it happen?

feedback.naturalExpression: When did it happen?
feedback.explanation: “when did”询问过去事件的方式或时间，已有“did”后动词用原形。

choices.text: Did you sleep with them?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did you sleep with them?
feedback.explanation: 直接问是否发生性关系，重点是核实具体事实；适合双方已经在讨论关系忠诚时使用。

choices.text: Were you planning to tell me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Were you planning to tell me?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: We kissed after we went out one night. I knew it was wrong, and I didn’t tell you.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long have you been hiding this from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long have you been hiding this from me?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Was there anything else between you two?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was there anything else between you two?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: I need the full truth now. Please don’t leave anything out.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need the full truth now. Please don’t leave anything out.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I don’t understand why you didn’t tell me yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t understand why you didn’t tell me yourself.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: I was afraid I’d lose you.

turns.prompt: 你想说明隐瞒对关系造成的影响，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hiding it didn’t protect our relationship. It made things worse.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hiding it didn’t protect our relationship. It made things worse.
feedback.explanation: “hiding it”把问题落在隐瞒这个行为上，说明信任为什么受到影响。

choices.text: I don’t know what to believe right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know what to believe right now.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

choices.text: I need some time to process what you’ve told me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need some time to process what you’ve told me.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

scenarios.title: B｜决定暂时分开
scenarios.setting: 在“发现对象出轨”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“决定暂时分开”。

turns.text: I’m sorry. I know I completely broke your trust.

turns.prompt: 你想提出暂时分开、留出思考空间，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think we need some time apart.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we need some time apart.
feedback.explanation: “time apart”表示需要个人空间或暂时分开冷静，能说明需求而不评价对方这个人。

choices.text: I’m not ready to decide what happens to us yet, but I need space.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not ready to decide what happens to us yet, but I need space.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I can’t act like everything is normal right now. I need some distance.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t act like everything is normal right now. I need some distance.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: For now, I think it’s better if we don’t see each other for a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: For now, I think it’s better if we don’t see each other for a while.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I want to separate with you for some time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we need some time apart.
feedback.explanation: 暂时分开用“some time apart”；“separate with you”不是这里的惯用说法。

turns.text: Are you breaking up with me?

turns.prompt: 关于「发现对象出轨」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’m saying I need time before I make that decision.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m saying I need time before I make that decision.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I don’t know yet. That’s why I need some space.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know yet. That’s why I need some space.
feedback.explanation: “need some space”表示需要个人空间或暂时分开冷静，能说明需求而不评价对方这个人。

choices.text: Right now, I’m too hurt to decide what I want long-term.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right now, I’m too hurt to decide what I want long-term.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’m not promising that we’ll get back together. I just need time to think.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not promising that we’ll get back together. I just need time to think.
feedback.explanation: “get back together”表示复合，问的是是否恢复恋爱关系，而不只是再见一面。

turns.prompt: 关于「发现对象出轨」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I don’t know. I’ll reach out when I’m ready to talk.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t know. I’ll reach out when I’m ready to talk.
feedback.explanation: “I don't know”如实说明不清楚，避免把猜测说成确定的信息。

choices.text: Give me a few days without contacting me, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Give me a few days without contacting me, please.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I can’t give you an exact answer right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t give you an exact answer right now.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Please don’t pressure me to decide immediately.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please don’t pressure me to decide immediately.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.prompt: 关于「发现对象出轨」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Thank you. That’s what I need right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. That’s what I need right now.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll contact you when I’m ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll contact you when I’m ready.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜决定结束关系
scenarios.setting: 玩家已经考虑过，决定不再继续这段关系。

turns.text: Can we please try to work through this?

turns.prompt: 关于「发现对象出轨」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’ve thought about it, and I want to end the relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve thought about it, and I want to end the relationship.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t think I can continue this relationship after what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I don’t think I can continue this relationship after what happened.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I don’t think I can rebuild the trust we had. I think we should break up.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I can rebuild the trust we had. I think we should break up.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I care about you, but this crossed a line I can’t move past.

feedback.naturalExpression: I care about you, but this crossed a line I can’t move past.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I want to break with you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve thought about it, and I want to end the relationship.
feedback.explanation: 与某人分手用“break up with”，不能漏掉“up”。

turns.text: You’re really ending everything over one mistake?

turns.prompt: 你想说明这件事为何触及自己的底线，会怎么说？

choices.text: For me, cheating isn’t a small mistake.

feedback.naturalExpression: For me, cheating isn’t a small mistake.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: It’s not just what happened. It’s also the lying and hiding it afterward.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s not just what happened. It’s also the lying and hiding it afterward.
feedback.explanation: “hiding it”把问题落在隐瞒这个行为上，说明信任为什么受到影响。

choices.text: I understand that you regret it, but I’ve made my decision.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand that you regret it, but I’ve made my decision.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: You don’t have to agree with my decision, but I need you to respect it.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t have to agree with my decision, but I need you to respect it.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

turns.text: What if I promise it’ll never happen again?

turns.prompt: 你想表达支持和祝愿，会怎么说？

choices.text: I hope you mean that, but my decision hasn’t changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I hope you mean that, but my decision hasn’t changed.
feedback.explanation: “I hope”表达希望而非保证，适合祝愿或说明对后续的期待。

choices.text: I’m not asking you to convince me. I’ve already decided.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not asking you to convince me. I’ve already decided.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: I don’t want to keep negotiating about this. The relationship is over.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to keep negotiating about this. The relationship is over.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t want to”明确表达自己的意愿或界限，后面的具体动作说明拒绝的是哪件事。

choices.text: I genuinely wish you well, but I need to move on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I genuinely wish you well, but I need to move on.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Take care of yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: Take care of yourself.
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。

choices.text: I think it’s best if we give each other space from now on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s best if we give each other space from now on.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。
